frameworks.name: LangGraph

primitives.next_step_decider: StateGraph edges, conditional edges, Send fan-out, LLM nodes
primitives.state_model: Typed state + Annotated reducers; Store for cross-thread KV
primitives.idempotency_stance: pending_writes_skip_successful_siblings; pre-interrupt side effects must be app-idempotent

production_breakage_modes: InMemorySaver in production loses state across deploys
subgraph persistence misconfig drops interrupt/resume
async durability lag / durability-mode interrupt edge cases
CTI overkill for linear tool agents

frameworks.name: OpenAI Agents SDK

primitives.next_step_decider: LLM tool choice including transfer_to_* handoff tools
primitives.state_model: Run context + Sessions (conversation history) + RunState for pauses
primitives.history_isolation: handoff input_filter / nest_handoff_history; guardrails do not apply to handoff calls
primitives.idempotency_stance: resume continues run; tool idempotency app-owned; Restate optional for durable agents

production_breakage_modes: handoff history leakage of tool args/results without filters
guardrail boundary surprises (first/final agent only; handoffs bypass tool guardrails)
sessions mistaken for crash-durable workflow state
tracing unavailable under ZDR

frameworks.name: AutoGen / AG2

primitives.next_step_decider: Channel adapters (conversation/consulting/discussion/workflow TransitionGraph); Classic GroupChat speaker selection
primitives.state_model: Hub WAL + adapter fold state + Context Variables + KnowledgeStore
primitives.hitl_mechanism: await context.input inside tool + hitl_hook; HumanClient participant
primitives.history_isolation: channel view policies / WindowedSummary / audience on envelopes
primitives.termination_bounds: TTL max_turns TerminateTarget; conversation never auto-closes
primitives.idempotency_stance: WAL replay for adapter state; side-effect idempotency app-owned

production_breakage_modes: unbounded conversation channel cost
Classic vs v1 package/import migration breaks
WAL poll timeouts missing messages
compaction drops working memory if only success events observed
simple_loop_wins_when: no debate or consensus protocol required
sequential research→write can be a workflow elsewhere

frameworks.name: CrewAI

primitives.state_model: Crew/task context + Flow self.state + hierarchical memory scopes
primitives.hitl_mechanism: task human_input; Flow @human_feedback; enterprise webhook HITL
primitives.history_isolation: task context parameters; memory scope tree
primitives.idempotency_stance: restore skips completed tasks; auto-checkpoint writes best-effort

production_breakage_modes: hierarchical without manager_llm/manager_agent
human feedback pollutes task context
HITL webhook resume URL drops
weak concurrent state race primitives vs graph reducers
simple_loop_wins_when: no need for Flows event graph

frameworks.name: Semantic Kernel / Magentic (→ MAF)

primitives.state_model: Agent threads / chat history; Magentic shared context + progress ledger
primitives.hitl_mechanism: group human participant; Magentic plan review HITL
primitives.idempotency_stance: experimental APIs; prefer MAF for greenfield durability story
primitives.observability_hooks: ILogger / App Insights gravity; less GenAI-span cookbook than AG2/ADK

production_breakage_modes: building on experimental SK orchestration before RC
double migration SK→MAF
Magentic open-ended loops without cost caps
Python/.NET feature skew
simple_loop_wins_when: solution path known (use sequential/handoff or non-SK workflow)
no need for Magentic-One-style generalist collaboration
greenfield can start on MAF instead of SK agents

frameworks.name: Google ADK

primitives.next_step_decider: Graph edges, dynamic programmatic workflows, collaborative coordinator, sequence/loop/parallel templates
primitives.hitl_mechanism: RequestInput HITL nodes (no model required); tool confirmation flows
primitives.idempotency_stance: rerunOnResume must be configured; non-idempotent tools at risk on re-run

production_breakage_modes: rerunOnResume double work
LiteLLM gaps vs Gemini-centric examples
compaction drops tool-critical details
experimental agent routing instability

frameworks.name: Mastra

primitives.idempotency_stance: built-in engine snapshots; Inngest runner for stronger durability

production_breakage_modes: using agents for predetermined multi-step ETL
using workflows for open-ended research
assuming built-in engine equals Inngest/Temporal without runner
smaller TS hiring pool than LG/Python
simple_loop_wins_when: product chat + tools + structured output only
pair VS UI without Mastra workflows

frameworks.name: Inngest durable agents / AgentKit

primitives.next_step_decider: Application loop; model chooses tools; optional AgentKit Network routers
primitives.state_model: Inngest run + step memoization; AgentKit shared State for networks
primitives.termination_bounds: function timeouts + loop limits in code
primitives.idempotency_stance: completed steps memoized on replay; keep nondeterminism inside steps

production_breakage_modes: nondeterminism outside step.run breaks replay
AgentKit Networks + platform CTI spike if learned together
not a RAG/UI framework — must compose with VS/MA
simple_loop_wins_when: runs finish within process lifetime and loss is OK
no need for step memoization of paid model calls

frameworks.name: Temporal (incl. PydanticAI integration)

primitives.next_step_decider: Deterministic workflow code; activities for model/tools/MCP
primitives.hitl_mechanism: signals / updates for human decisions; long-running workflows
primitives.idempotency_stance: activities retried from start; must be idempotent or heartbeat-aware

production_breakage_modes: I/O inside workflow code breaks determinism
non-idempotent activities double side effects on retry
ops burden of workers/server for teams that only needed a chat loop
simple_loop_wins_when: team has no Temporal ops capacity

findings.title: Control planes optimize different failure units
findings.claim: LG super-step checkpoints, Inngest/Temporal step/activity memoization, OA RunState+sessions, AG2 WAL folds, and Crew task checkpoints are not interchangeable 'stateful agent' features.
findings.falsifier: Demonstrate semantic equivalence of resume-after-kill for a non-idempotent payment tool across LG interrupt, OA session resume, and Inngest step.run without app idempotency keys.

findings.title: HITL quality is ternary, not binary
findings.claim: Deterministic nodes (ADK RequestInput, Crew @human_feedback, Mastra suspend), approval interruptions (OA needs_approval), and in-tool pauses (AG2 context.input, LG interrupt) are distinct; prompt-only ask-user is not a control plane.
findings.falsifier: Show compliance auditors accept prompt-only HITL as equivalent to RequestInput/interrupt resume with durable persistence.

findings.title: Highest CS does not minimize rewrite hazard
findings.claim: LangGraph CS=95 coexists with higher RHS than Mastra/OA because CTI + weak RACS + checkpoint lock-in dominate 12-month stack survival.
findings.falsifier: LG-first teams rewrite primary orchestration less often than MA/PD at equal multi-agent complexity.

findings.title: Topology false friends are the top POC-to-prod killer
findings.claim: OA handoffs, AG2 channels/GroupChat, Crew hierarchical, and Magentic are not synonyms; they diverge on speaker cardinality, termination, history visibility, and pause determinism.
findings.falsifier: A single isolation+cost spec satisfied unchanged by OA handoff, AG2 discussion, and Crew hierarchical on the same task.

findings.title: Durable engines beat framework checkpointers for zero-compute waits
findings.claim: Multi-hour/day approvals should use Temporal signals or Inngest waitForEvent; framework checkpointers keep place but do not match engine wait/memoization contracts.
findings.falsifier: Framework checkpointer alone provides worker-free multi-day wait with model-call memoization equivalent to Inngest/Temporal.

findings.title: Simple tool loops dominate the median production agent
findings.claim: Most shipped agents never need fan-out, debate, or Magentic; over-selecting rich planes raises CTI/failure surface without KPI lift.
findings.falsifier: Product analytics show >50% of production runs use ≥3 agents with non-linear topology in a representative SaaS cohort.

findings.title: Microsoft and AG2 carry succession tax on the control plane itself
findings.claim: SK experimental orchestration→MAF and AG Classic→Network v1 make the coordination API unstable even when model adapters are fine.
findings.falsifier: SK orchestration frozen as LTS without MAF pressure for 24 months AND AG2 v1 drop-in compatible with Classic.

findings.title: Compose layers; do not seek one framework for UI + graph + durability
findings.claim: Winning stacks layer typed UX × orchestration × durability; single-framework absolutism under-hardens or over-taxes.
findings.falsifier: Single package matching VS UI DX + MA workflow FMC + Inngest/Temporal PH without adjacency.
